map.title: Restore + reapply

templates.title: Iteration A prompt
templates.text: I am providing the current index.html, style.css, app.js and data.json from a small vanilla dashboard. First tell me which existing files should change and why. Then propose the smallest useful change that adds a KPI named 'Completed learners' calculated from learner.completed. Do not hard-code 6. Do not change data.json. Do not add frameworks, packages, a backend, database, chart library or unrelated refactoring. If the current files are not available to you, ask me to provide them instead of inventing their structure.

templates.title: Iteration B prompt
templates.text: I am now providing the current post-Iteration-A files. Add one control labelled 'Show learners needing follow-up'. Reuse the existing learner data and rendering logic. When active, show only learners where completed is false; allow returning to all learners. Keep the smallest vanilla HTML/JavaScript change. Do not modify data.json, add frameworks/packages/backend/database/libraries, or refactor unrelated code. First tell me which files should change and why.

templates.title: Repository-root recovery — Windows
templates.text:
Set-Location (git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
git status --short
git diff -- dashboard
git diff --output="$env:TEMP\day2-dashboard.patch" -- dashboard
Test-Path "$env:TEMP\day2-dashboard.patch"
git restore --staged --worktree -- dashboard
git apply "$env:TEMP\day2-dashboard.patch"

map.title: Розібрати pipeline
map.note: Request → application rules → model → tool/source → response/log

templates.title: Canonical grounded request
templates.text: My teaching-format choice is guided dialogue. Use the approved learning card to give me one short hint about which two card facts best support my choice and one limitation I should acknowledge. Keep me as the author of the final answer.

templates.title: Bounded instruction-improvement request
templates.text: I will provide the current instruction string from activity.json. Explain what it currently asks the educational agent to do, then propose one clearer alternative that preserves learner authorship, uses the approved learning card when evidence is needed, avoids invented evidence, and keeps support short and focused. Change only the instruction wording. Do not change task, hint_question, allowed_material_id, tools, files, Python code, routes, packages, memory, RAG, web access or any capability.
